name: @caotang/import-docx
description: The Word reader for the DOCX import (#279): an own reader on the shared zip and XML layer — styles and their basedOn chains, outline levels, lists, quotes, tracked changes in accept/reject/keep, footnotes and endnotes inline, comments as notes, pictures through the relationships, tables as paragraphs and a TOC that never becomes chapters. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
